# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge
We as members, contributors, and leaders pledge to make participation in this
community a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body
size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender
identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status,
nationality, personal appearance, race, caste, religion, or sexual identity
and orientation.

We pledge to act and interact in ways that contribute to an open, welcoming,
diverse, inclusive, and healthy community.

## Community Guidelines
**Be kind.** Assume good faith. Critique ideas, not people.

**Be respectful.** Aggressive language, personal attacks, discrimination, and
sexualized attention have no place here.

**Be considerate.** We are a global project — consider time zones, languages,
and access.

**Give and accept constructive feedback.** If you are criticized, respond
constructively. If you are in the wrong, apologise and learn.

## Enforcement
Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behaviour may be
reported to the project maintainer. Complaints will be reviewed and investigated
promptly and fairly. The project team is obligated to maintain confidentiality
with regard to the reporter of an incident.

## Scope
This Code of Conduct applies in all community spaces, in any one-on-one
interactions, and in all public spaces where a member of the community is
representing the project.

## Attribution
Based on the [Contributor Covenant, v2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
